claim: The package download installs and runs in a clean npm project.
sandbox: download the built tarball from the site, install it in a new temporary project, and run create/encode/decode

claim: Card encoding and decoding preserves exact typed settings.
sandbox: create the documented card and compare the complete decoded object and value types

claim: The demo exports the current card as JSON.
sandbox: demo card with changed name and pitch; inspect the downloaded filename and JSON values

claim: The demo sends the current card to browser print.
sandbox: demo data with a browser print spy; assert the action calls the print path

claim: A QR settings link reopens exact values in a fresh browser.
where: landing how-it-works section, card share panel, README
sandbox: change every sample control, create the QR link, and reopen it in a separate browser context

claim: Standard share links leave out WAV audio.
where: landing facts, card share panel, privacy, README
sandbox: encode a card containing WAV data both with and without the explicit includeAudio option

claim: The demo renders and downloads a WAV on the device.
sandbox: render sample audio, verify the RIFF/WAVE file, and assert no external request occurs during rendering

claim: Cards can be saved and deleted locally while demo data stays separate from real data.
where: landing facts, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: seed a real-data sentinel, save and delete a demo card, reset the sample, and prove the sentinel is unchanged

claim: The card maker works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; warm the demo and service worker, go offline, reload, and verify the ready card

claim: The site uses no accounts, analytics, advertising cookies, or third-party runtime services.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record a full save/share/export flow, origins, cookies, and browser storage keys

claim: The MIT package ships ESM, CommonJS, declarations, CSS, schema, and the format guide.
sandbox: install the built tarball in a clean project, require CommonJS, and inspect installed artifact files and license metadata

claim: Version 1 validation rejects unknown versions and damaged share codes.
where: landing install section, format guide, README
sandbox: validate a future-version card and decode a damaged code; assert clear failures

claim: The widget works by keyboard and has accessible native controls.
sandbox: demo data; operate range and toggle by keyboard, inspect focus, and run axe WCAG A/AA

claim: Including audio requires creator, source, and license details.
where: landing install section, terms, format guide, README
sandbox: validate an audio attachment with missing rights fields and assert each required-field error

claim: Valid JSON cards open, while invalid files leave the current card unchanged.
sandbox: demo data; import a valid boundary card, then a malformed file, and compare the visible card after each
